title: Automate CI: artifact rotation, signing, and opaque pin policy for profile publishes
creator: Morgan Lee
description: We need a robust CI job flow that automates build artifact rotation, cryptographic signing, and publishing of performance profiles with an opaque pin policy. Current onboarding requires multiple manual steps (build, upload, sign, pin, publish) that slow model rollouts and increase human error. This ticket will design and implement a pipeline to: (1) create canonical, reproducible model artifacts; (2) rotate older artifacts to an archival store with TTL; (3) sign artifacts with our KMS-backed key and generate verifiable provenance metadata; (4) publish performance profiles to the profile registry and automatically create a pin entry (opaque pin) that surfaces to runtime without exposing internal storage paths; and (5) provide a rollback and canary promotion mechanism in case signed profiles fail evaluation.
acceptance_criteria: End-to-end CI job triggered by model-onboard PR that builds model artifact, runs deterministic unit tests, and produces a signed artifact bundle
Artifact signing uses KMS and produces a signature bundle and provenance manifest that matches runtime verifier expectations
Pipeline rotates older artifact bundles to archival storage and emits an archival index entry; archival TTL is configurable via pipeline input
Publishing step registers a performance profile and creates an opaque pin token (no direct storage path in pin) visible to runtime routing policies
Rollback path: ability to mark a pin as retracted and create an emergency fast-fallback to previous signed profile
Automated smoke evals run after publish (stable & canary) and failure causes publish to be flagged and canary to be auto-retracted
Documentation and runbook added: how to inspect signatures, force re-sign, and emergency rollback steps
End-to-end tests in CI that verify signature verification, pin resolution, and runtime retrieval against a staging runtime
tasks: Design pipeline DAG and create pipeline template (build -> sign -> publish -> rotate -> smoke-eval)
Integrate with KMS for ephemeral signing keys and key rotation support
Implement opaque pin abstraction in profile registry API and storage layer
Add archival/rotation worker and configurable TTL parameter to pipeline inputs
Wire CI job to trigger smoke eval suite and gate publish on success/failure policy
Create CLI helper for manual emergency re-sign and pin retraction
Add telemetry events for publish/sign/rotate to observability (console dashboard)
Write unit/integration tests and update onboarding docs and runbook
risks: If signing key compromise occurs, all pinned profiles may need reissuance — need rotation and revocation playbook
Opaque pin abstraction might require small runtime changes; backward compatibility must be preserved
Automated rotation could delete artifacts needed for forensic analysis if TTL misconfigured
Smoke eval flakiness could cause false retractions; need stable eval harness and retry windows
notes: Prefer using existing attestation schema (see ENG-41213) for provenance manifest fields to reduce runtime parsing changes
Keep opaque pin token short-lived in control plane cache to allow safe immediate rollbacks
Consider embedding a pointer to a signed digest and a notarization timestamp rather than a raw storage path
Work with Security (SRE/Sec) early for KMS IAM policy and HSM usage guidance
